description: Scrape Letterboxd films, reviews, lists, browse pages, people filmographies, and public member activity. No login, cookies, API key, or proxy setup is required.

browseUrl.description: Browse mode. Paste any Letterboxd /films/ page, for example /films/genre/horror/, /films/decade/1990s/, /films/year/2024/, /films/language/japanese/, /films/country/japan/, /films/theme/..., /films/on/netflix/, or /films/by/rating/.
browseUrl.title: Browse page URL

crewSlug.description: Used by Filmographies mode. Letterboxd's URL slug, e.g. christopher-nolan, a24, or japan. Full profile URLs are accepted too.
crewSlug.title: Person, studio, or country slug

crewType.description: Used by Filmographies mode. Choose the role Letterboxd serves for the person or entity.
crewType.title: Filmography role

diaryYear.description: Diary mode only. Leave empty for the current year.
diaryYear.title: Diary year

enrichSearchResults.description: Search mode only. Off returns fast stubs. On visits each film page for full metadata, stats, and filters.
enrichSearchResults.title: Load full film pages for search results

filmSlug.description: Used by Reviews mode. A slug or full film URL.
filmSlug.title: Film for reviews

filmSlugs.description: Used by Films mode. Paste slugs (parasite-2019) or full Letterboxd film URLs. One record per film.
filmSlugs.title: Film slugs or URLs

genre.description: Optional genre filter. Popular films uses it in the browse URL; other modes use it to filter film records.
genre.sectionCaption: Optional filters. Filters that need full film data trigger a film-page fetch for accuracy.
genre.title: Genre

includeAvailability.description: Adds the current region's streaming/rent/buy/disc offers and the trailer URL when Letterboxd publishes them. One extra request per film.
includeAvailability.title: Include where-to-watch offers and trailer

includeStatistics.description: Adds watched / list / like counts, Top 500 rank, and the half-star rating histogram. Two extra requests per film; off for the smallest daily run.
includeStatistics.title: Include film statistics and rating histogram

listUrl.description: Lists mode. Paste a member or official list URL to get one list record plus its films. Leave empty to get the popular-lists index for the chosen period.
listUrl.title: List URL

maxRating.description: 0-500 scale (450 = 4.5 out of 5). Drop films above this.
maxRating.title: Maximum average rating

maxYear.description: Drop films released after this year.
maxYear.title: Latest release year

minRating.description: 0-500 scale (350 = 3.5 out of 5). Drop films below this.
minRating.title: Minimum average rating

minRatingsCount.description: Drop films with fewer member ratings than this.
minRatingsCount.title: Minimum ratings count

minYear.description: Drop films released before this year.
minYear.title: Earliest release year

mode.description: Pick the kind of Letterboxd page you want. Every mode returns real public data and drops empty fields.
enumTitles: One list or the popular-lists index
Reviews for one film (sort and rating filters)
Films by a person, studio, or country
mode.sectionCaption: Choose a mode and provide its target below.
mode.title: What to scrape

popularPeriod.description: Used by Popular films and the popular-lists index.
popularPeriod.title: Popular period

proxy.description: Optional. The actor works without any proxy; supply an Apify Proxy configuration only if your network needs one.
proxy.sectionCaption: Optional proxy. Leave empty for the default direct connection.
proxy.title: Apify Proxy (optional)

reviewFullText.description: Reviews mode only. Fetch the full body for truncated reviews (one extra request per truncated review).
reviewFullText.title: Load full review text

reviewRating.description: Reviews mode only. Exact half-star filter, or unrated reviews.
reviewRating.title: Only reviews with this rating

searchQuery.description: Used by Search mode. Letterboxd's autocomplete returns at most 100 matching films per query; use Films mode with explicit slugs for a deeper list.
searchQuery.title: Search query

userFilmRating.description: Watched films mode only. Exact half-star filter.
userFilmRating.title: Only watched films with this rating

username.description: Used by all member modes. The handle without @, or a profile URL.
username.title: Member username

title: Letterboxd Scraper Input
